$comment: Single source of truth for products. Edit this file to change products, prices, stock or payment links. Prices are EUR. null = unknown (product shows 'Price on request' and cannot be added to the cart). Every 'todo' entry is something the owner still needs to confirm; see docs/PRODUCTS.md. The 'Under €25' gift guide is filled automatically with every product that can be bought and costs €25 or less; the 'under-25' tag in a product's guides list does not change it (it only affects 'You may also like' suggestions). Image 'file' names refer to wwwroot/images/products/<file>-<width>.webp generated by ClientApp/scripts/process-images.mjs.
